reason: A Discord integration for remotely monitoring and controlling DeepSeek Harness workspaces, including session inspection, live updates, workspace management, and optional agent execution from Discord.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 工作区映射到 Discord 频道，用于查看会话轨迹、监控子智能体并可选地远程驱动智能体。
summaries.en: Maps DeepSeek Harness workspaces to Discord channels for inspecting session activity, monitoring subagents, and optionally driving agents remotely.

capabilities: Reads workspace sessions, trajectories, timelines, subagents, lineage, context, and todo data
Streams harness activity to Discord when mirroring is enabled
Registers workspaces and changes model, preset, and permission settings
Can send prompts to agents, run harness commands, stop or rewind sessions, and permit agent file and command execution when allowRun is enabled
